forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8880'
+title: 'Scroll perf 6: scroll to the bottom by the edge, not by an id outside the ForEach'
+---
+User request (2026-11-25): "scrolling is still way too slow", stay with SwiftUI. The scroll profile found `ForEachState.firstOffset` "findNoMatch" at 2% of main-thread time: a scroll position lookup of an id that no `ForEach` element has.
+
+## What
+
+- `Sources/AgentViewKit/Thread/ConversationView.swift`: the bottom view has `.id(ConversationLayout.bottomIdentifier)` (about line 380), and `position.scrollTo(id:anchor:)` (about lines 585 and 600) and the scroll position binding use ids. Find each place where the bottom id goes into the scroll position, and use `position.scrollTo(edge: .bottom)` there.
+- [ ] Remove the bottom id from the scroll position lookup. Keep `ConversationLayout.bottomIdentifier` only if a test or the accessibility tree needs it.
+- [ ] Keep the pin to the bottom, the follow of a streamed answer and the Scroll to Bottom pill the same.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] The scroll position never holds the bottom id.
+- [ ] The pin, follow and pill tests pass with no change.
+
+## Tests
+
+- [ ] The existing tests of the scroll anchors (`Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Infrastructure/ScrollAnchorManagerTests.swift`) and of the pill pass.
+- [ ] New test: after a scroll to the bottom, the scroll position of the list has no id (`position.viewID == nil`) and its edge is `.bottom`.
+- [ ] `HOME=$(mktemp -d) swift test` passes with 0 failures and 0 warnings.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #perf
\ No newline at end of file
